Title: Relates to providing an owner of real property exempt from taxation time to re-apply for such exemption if such exemption was not renewed
Summary: Provides that an owner of real property exempt from taxation may re-apply for such exemption within thirty days of receiving a property tax bill if such exemption was required to be renewed and was not renewed.
ActClause: AN ACT to amend the real property tax law, in relation to providing an owner of real property exempt from taxation time to re-apply for such exemption if such exemption was not renewed
